pages.title: Inquiry Received | ExactMec
pages.h1: Your Mold Inquiry Has Been Received
pages.intro: Thank you for sharing your project details. We will review your information and follow up about this inquiry.
body: Keep this reference for your project conversation. If you have drawings or a sample, we will discuss how to share them before preparing a formal quotation.
You can also continue on WhatsApp and mention your reference. Your inquiry remains saved even if you do not send a WhatsApp message.
pages.layout_cn: 单栏确认卡，参考编号可复制；下面可选WhatsApp，再放流程链接。无追加必填字段，无重复询价表，无倒计时。
pages.gate_cn: 仅在服务端确认已保存且当前会话可访问reference时显示。直接访问无有效提交态，显示下面fallback；noindex，不进sitemap。

fallback.text: No submitted inquiry is available in this session. Tell us about your project using the inquiry form.
fallback.label: Request a Mold Quote

pages.title: Page Not Found | ExactMec
pages.h1: We Could Not Find That Page
pages.intro: The page may have moved, or the link may be incomplete. You can explore our mold tooling or start a new inquiry.
pages.layout_cn: 简洁单栏错误页，保留导航与页脚；两个主要路径，不放虚假搜索框。
pages.gate_cn: 这是404模板标识，实际未命中URL返回HTTP404和noindex；不得统一重定向首页或返回200。
